# Redesign Native-Graph Node Metadata Schema

Evaluate and define exactly what mandatory metadata attributes a graph node requires for capability gap analysis. Ensure nodes possess enough semantic richness for downstream traversal scripts to yield highly meaningful outputs.

## Timeline

### @tobiu - 2026-04-08T09:51:36Z

Task complete via integration of the new Node metadata and edge ontology schema directly into the DreamService prompt payload, GraphService database linking mechanisms, and Sandman Playwright assertions.
